Name: Vegan Community Center Bundles
Author: YukiDelValle
Description:
I tried to make the balancing as similar as the vanilla version as possible. Feel free to report bugs and send suggestions!
No recipe requires leveling up the combat skill.
(Will eventually post screenshots of all the bundles)

Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.4!

What is changed?

﻿ ﻿The reward for the [b]Fall Crops Bundle[/b] is a now Seed Maker.

﻿ ﻿The [b]Animal Bundle [/b]is now the [b]Cleaning Bundle[/b], it requires:

[list]
[*]Trash
[*]Soggy Newspaper
[*]Broken CD
[*]Broken Glasses
[/list] ﻿Reward: Recycling Machine

﻿ ﻿The [b]Artisan Bundle[/b] requires:

[list]
[*]Oil
[*]Bok Choy
[*]Garlic
[*]Hops
[*]Pickles
[/list]
﻿ ﻿The [b]Adventurer's Bundle[/b] is now the [b]Explorer's Bundle[/b], it requires:

[list]
[*]Ancient Doll
[*]Rusty Cog
[*]Chicken Statue
[*]Glass Shards
[/list] ﻿Reward: Small Glow Ring

﻿ ﻿The [b]Chef's Bundle [/b]requires:

[list]
[*]Rice
[*]Salad
[*]Tortilla
[/list] ﻿Reward: Red Plate (3)

﻿ ﻿The [b]Dye Bundle[/b] requires:

[list]
[*]Sweet Pea
[*]Tea Leaves
[/list] ﻿Reward: Tapper

﻿ ﻿The [b]Field Research Bundle[/b] requires:

[list]
[*]Morel
[*]Cactus Fruit
[/list] ﻿Reward: Small Magnet Ring

﻿ ﻿The [b]Fodder Bundle[/b] is now the [b]Scythe[/b] [b]Bundle[/b], it requires:

[list]
[*]Wheat (5)
[*]Amaranth (5)
[*]Kale (5)
[/list] ﻿Reward: Oil maker

﻿ ﻿The [b]Enchanter's Bundle[/b] requires:

[list]
[*]Diamond
[/list]
﻿ ﻿The reward for the [b]2,500g Vault Bundle[/b] is now Vegetable Medley.

﻿ ﻿The [b]River Fish Bundle[/b] is now the Snacks Bundle, it requires:

[list]
[*]Fried Mushroom
[*]Hashbrowns
[*]Tortilla
[*]Roasted Hazelnuts
[/list] ﻿Reward: Oil (10)

﻿ ﻿The [b]Lake Fish Bundle[/b] is now the [b]Beverages Bundle[/b], it requires:

[list]
[*]Beer
[*]Coffee
[*]Green Tea
[*]Juice
[/list] ﻿Reward: Keg

﻿ ﻿The [b]Ocean Fish Bundle[/b] is now the [b]Flowers Bundle[/b], it requires:

[list]
[*]Tulip
[*]Summer Spangle
[*]Fairy Rose
[*]Blue Jazz
[/list] ﻿Reward: Warp Totem: Desert (5)

﻿ ﻿The [b]Night FIsh Bundle[/b] is now the [b]Underrated Bundle[/b], it requires:

[list]
[*]Spring Onion
[*]Holly
[*]Chanterelle
[/list] ﻿Reward: Iridium Sprinkler

﻿ ﻿The [b]Crab Pot Bundle[/b] is now the[b] Dessert Bundle[/b], it requires:

[list]
[*]Maple Bar
[*]Poppyseed Muffin
[*]Blackberry Cobbler
[*]Plum Pudding
[*]Cranberry Sauce
[/list] ﻿Reward: Sugar (10)

﻿ ﻿The [b]Specialty Bundle[/b] is now the[b] Sparkly Bundle[/b], it requires:

[list]
[*]Alamite
[*]Aerinite
[*]Geminite
[*]Ocean Stone
[/list] ﻿Reward: Crystalarium

﻿ ﻿The [b]Missing Bundle[/b] requires:

[list]
[*]Pale Ale (gold)
[*]Iridium Ore
[*]Super Meal
[/list]
﻿ ﻿Thanks for downloading, have fun!
